jobs.description: Are you looking for an energetic weekend job where you can put your leadership skills into practice? Furthermore- You are available to work every Saturday for one of the two designated shifts.- You have an excellent command of the English language (our main language on the floor).- You preferably have some experience in logistics, warehousing, or a supervisory role.- You are decisive, responsible, and focus on both safety and efficiency.What will you doAs a Logistic Team Leader at BPO Services, you are the engine of the weekend operation. As a warehouse worker at UPS Amsterdam, you are essential to the logistics process. You sort packages, load and unload trucks, and move goods internally with a pallet jack. You work Monday through Friday, between 3:00 and 8:00 PM, at least four days a week. This is a part-time job, ideal if you want to arrange your days flexibly or work alongside your studies or other activities. On a typical day, you check in, join your team, and get started together to make sure the packages get to the right place on time. You work accurately and enjoy teaming up with colleagues to get the job done. Thanks to your efforts, the logistics process runs smoothly and customers get their packages on time.Who are you? You’re a go-getter who enjoys physical work and likes to reach goals together with others. You’re flexible, work accurately, and don’t get stressed easily when it gets busy. You’re a team player and you care about packages being processed safely and on time. You live within 20 kilometers of the Amsterdam location.Requirements:- At least 1 year experience in logistics- Available for at least 4 afternoons/evenings per week- Able to do physical work (lifting packages, walking, standing)- You speak and understand English and/or Dutch- You are able to get a VOG

What will you do?As an order picker, you ensure that orders are collected quickly and accurately. Using a hand scanner and tablet, you locate the correct products and transport them using an electric pallet truck (EPT). Once you’ve mastered the job, you’ll have the opportunity to obtain your reach truck certificate and possibly grow into an all-round warehouse employee.Your responsibilities include:- Picking orders using a hand scanner and tablet- Driving an EPT (electric pallet truck)- Checking and preparing orders for shipmentWho are you?- You have at least 1 year of experience as an order picker or warehouse employee- You speak Dutch and/or English- You have an EPT certificate — don’t have one yet? No problem! You can obtain it through Met Louie- You are willing to work shifts (06:00–15:00 and 10:00–19:00)Where will you work?You will join a leading company in the import, production, and distribution of authentic Asian food products. From modern production facilities and distribution centers, thousands of hospitality businesses and supermarkets across Europe are supplied daily. With a strong focus on quality, innovation, and service, the company strives to make Asian cuisine accessible to everyone.What we offer you:- A monthly salary between €2,500 and €2,800 gross- A modern workplace in Haps, equipped with excellent facilities- 25 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment)- Pension plan according to the applicable collective agreement- A direct contract with the employer- Travel allowance, development opportunities, and… Friday fries day!

Are you an avid cleaner or cleaner? Do you want to make sure that vacationing guests can start their vacation with a good feeling? Then read on quickly! On these days it is important that the bungalows and vacation homes are cleaned properly. You do this with a whole team of enthusiastic and motivated cleaners.
